external.description: Third-party imports (declared in go.mod/package.json/pyproject): allow (default) or forbid.

internal.description: Which declared modules this module may import. A list is an allow-list ([] = none); {allow, deny} expresses both directions.

severity.description: Violation severity: error (default), warn, or info.

params.description: Rule parameters, validated against the extension's declared JSON Schema before any extension code runs.

severity.description: Violation severity: error (default), warn, or info.

type.description: Extension rule type name, registered by a defineRule() in .arclint/extensions/.

allow.description: Modules allowed to import the protected module.

kind.description: layers: ordered stack. forbidden: from-set must not import to-set. independence: no imports among siblings. protected: importable only by allow. acyclic: no cycles.

layers.description: Module names ordered highest first; imports go same-or-lower only.

modules.description: Module set for independence/acyclic (empty acyclic = all declared).

assert.description: expr-lang predicate over `file` (path, lines, imports); false is a violation.

case.description: kebab-case, snake_case, camelCase, PascalCase, or regex:<pattern>; combine alternatives with |.

files.description: Glob narrowing the rule to matching files inside the module.

kind.description: naming: file-stem case convention. structure: require/forbid path globs. content: must/must_not regexes. expr: a predicate over each file.

description.description: What this module is for; shown by arclint module ls/info.

paths.description: Path globs defining membership. A glob naming a directory owns its whole subtree.

each.description: Regex over the module's file paths; each named-capture tuple creates one obligation (registration).

kind.description: registration: every capture of `each` must have a `match` hit in the `in` module. correspondence: the value set of `of` relates to the value set of `in`.

match.description: Regex template over `each` captures that must hit inside the `in` module's files (registration).

of.description: Capture side deriving the obligated value set (correspondence).

relation.description: subset (default): every of-value exists in in-values; equal: both sets match exactly (correspondence).

exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from the walk, in addition to built-ins (.git, vendor, node_modules, .arclint).

include_testdata.description: Scan testdata directories, which Go convention excludes by default.

unknown_imports.description: Policy for imports that classify neither internal, external, nor stdlib: warn (default), error, ignore.

description: Architecture contracts: modules, consumes/provides/invariants clauses, and graph-wide dependency rules.

contracts.description: Per-module contracts keyed by module name: consumes (what it may import), provides (what it must supply), invariants (what always holds).

dependencies.description: Graph-wide dependency rules spanning modules: layers, forbidden, independence, protected, acyclic.

modules.description: Named file sets (path globs) that every rule refers to. A value is a glob list, or {paths, description} to document the module.

rules.description: Instances of TypeScript extension rule types from .arclint/extensions/, validated against each extension's declared params schema.

runtime.description: Language targets to analyze: go, ts, py. Activates per-language import extraction and classification.

scan.description: Tree walk tuning: exclude globs, testdata inclusion, unknown-import policy.
